name: van_power
description: Standalone HACS-compatible Home Assistant custom card for the Van Power 3D dashboard

scripts.check: npm run build && node --check van-power-card.js && gltf-transform validate van.glb && node scripts/compare-model.mjs
scripts.optimize:model: gltf-transform optimize assets/van.source.glb van.glb --compress meshopt --flatten false --join false --instance false --palette false --prune false --resample false --simplify false --sparse false --weld false --texture-compress webp --texture-size 2048
